rules.discord.discrimination.not-condone.message: We do not condone or support any acts of "-isms." If you are found perpetrating any of these, you will face administrative action.

rules.discord.drama.be-kind.message: Be kind and strive to keep negativity and drama out of all server chat channels, including in-game.

rules.discord.drama.no-toxicity.message: Toxicity and animosity in public chat channels will not be tolerated.

rules.discord.drama.private-disputes.message: All disputes must be handled privately. If you are caught arguing disrespectfully with another person, you may face consequences for inciting drama..

rules.discord.harassment.soliciting.message: Soliciting private information about another person

rules.discord.illegal.behavior.message: Promotion, encouragement, or engagement in any illegal behavior is unlawful and prohibited. Topics will be reported to Discord'a Trust & Safety team. You may be removed from the platform and potentially reported to local law enforcement.

rules.discord.scope.nickname.message: Change your nickname to your Minecraft in-game name. This prevents confusion and keeps the community organized.

rules.discord.spam.disrespect.message: Abuse and disrespect towards other players and staff members is prohibited. If you are caught doing these things, you may receive a warning.

rules.discord.spam.subtitle.message: Don't flood channels or abuse mentions

rules.hero.main.subtitle.message: A nine-year-old community runs on trust. These keep it that way.

rules.hero.market.subtitle.message: Every approved player can buy or sell almost anything in our market area within Spawn.

rules.main.bases.claim-structures.message: Players are allowed to claim structures outside of their main base. You may claim one of any individual type of structure. Examples include an ocean monument, nether fortress, or pillager tower. After claiming clearly with signs, players are expected to use structures within 30 days.

rules.main.bases.marked.message: Ensure your base is marked with pillars/signs in each corner or a full border.

rules.main.bases.max-size.message: Bases shall not exceed 750 blocks square (750x750) in size.

rules.main.bases.scout-area.message: Prior to claiming your base, thoroughly scout the area, including caves, to ensure the area isn't already claimed. Use common sense. If there are torches, signs, crops planted, livestock in pens, etc., it's obvious the area is inhabited. If you are in doubt, contact a staff member via support ticket for assistance.

rules.main.bases.subtitle.message: Player claimed areas in the overworld

rules.main.cta.description.message: Now that you've read the rules, hop into our Discord and fill out the application to join the SMP.

rules.main.end.builds.message: Farms and builds of any type are not allowed on the main end island without staff approval. You may build farms in the outer end islands (x/z coords +/- 1000). Temporary beacons are allowed to aide in mining obsidian pillars.

rules.main.end.first-dragon-fight.message: The first dragon fight and opening of the end is scheduled after the start of each map. No one is allowed to go to the End dimension before this time.

rules.main.end.no-enderman-farms.message: No personal Enderman farms. Server provides a public Enderman farm.

rules.main.end.subtitle.message: Dragon fights, farms, and the outer islands

rules.main.gameplay.client-mods.message: Client mods that give an unfair advantage are not allowed. A few exceptions exist — when in doubt, open a ticket.

rules.main.gameplay.heads-up.message: <highlight>Heads up:</highlight> all player actions are logged. Getting caught is unavoidable.

rules.main.gameplay.no-bugs.message: No in-game bugs, glitches, or exploits. Exception: breaking bedrock on nether roof or world base in your own base area with TNT & piston is allowed.

rules.main.gameplay.no-duplication.message: No item duplication. TNT duplication is allowed.

rules.main.gameplay.no-griefing.message: No griefing — damaging anything that isn't yours.

rules.main.gameplay.no-hacks.message: No fly hacks, speed hacks, PvP hacks, free camera.

rules.main.gameplay.no-lagging.message: No intentional lagging or crashing the server.

rules.main.gameplay.no-outside-items.message: Don't bring items in from outside the game.

rules.main.gameplay.no-rearranging.message: Don't rearrange items in containers that aren't yours.

rules.main.gameplay.no-scripts.message: No scripts, macros, auto-loggers, auto-clickers, auto-miners.

rules.main.gameplay.no-stealing.message: No stealing. Don't take from bases, chests, farms, or spawn without permission.

rules.main.gameplay.no-xray.message: No xray (vanilla exploit, mods, resource packs, etc.).

rules.main.gameplay.pvp-consent.message: PvP requires consent from all parties. Indirect harm via traps counts.

rules.main.gameplay.seed-private.message: Server seed is private. Don't share, request, or use it.

rules.main.gameplay.subtitle.message: No hacks, no cheats, no exploits — play fairly

Supporter's bases are safe from inactivity rollback.

rules.main.inactivity.no-claiming.message: At no point can another player claim an inactive base or take items from it.

rules.main.inactivity.structure-claims.message: Extra claims of structures from any rank player outside of their main base are not safe from inactivity. Examples: nether fortress, ocean monument. If you've claimed a structure and not used it in more than 60 days, staff may reclaim it.

rules.main.inactivity.subtitle.message: What happens to your base while you're away

rules.main.joining.low-effort.message: Incomplete or low effort applications may be denied.

rules.main.joining.lying.message: Any player found to have lied on their application prior to, or anytime after being accepted, is subject to an immediate ban.

rules.main.joining.no-review-requests.message: Do not ask staff to review your application.

rules.main.joining.read-rules.message: Read all of the rules in full before applying.

rules.main.joining.usernames.message: Inappropriate Minecraft usernames or skins will not be accepted unless changed.

rules.main.lag.afk-hostile-farms.message: AFKing at hostile mob farms is allowed only when mobs die immediately and don't build up.

rules.main.lag.auto-collection.message: Limit auto-collection (minecarts/hoppers) to as few as possible. Cover hoppers with solid blocks where applicable.

rules.main.lag.guardian-farms.message: Guardian farms cannot exceed 20x20x20 (the Guardian spawning area).

rules.main.lag.mob-farm-switch.message: Mob farms must have an on/off switch where possible.

rules.main.lag.no-chunk-loaders.message: No chunk loaders of any kind.

rules.main.lag.no-mega-sorters.message: No mega item sorters or excessively large redstone builds. Staff may ask you to fix or remove anything causing significant lag.

rules.main.lag.staff-may-disable.message: Staff may disable any farm causing significant lag or otherwise breaking the rules.

rules.main.lag.villager-breeders.message: Breeders must not let over 24 villagers build up at a time.

rules.main.market.area.message: A designated market area is provided at spawn for all players to participate in after approval.

rules.main.market.no-shops-elsewhere.message: Players cannot set up shops, signs, chests, or advertisements in any other part of spawn or public server area without permission or in a predesignated area. This includes the Spawn portion of the nether. This includes the overworld, nether, and main end island. The only exception is within your own market plot/stall.

rules.main.market.read-rules.message: Players are required to read the <market-rules-link>Market rules</market-rules-link> before starting their own Market Stall or Shop in spawn.

rules.main.market.sell-from-base.message: Players are allowed to sell items from their base or personal nether tunnel area.

rules.main.market.subtitle.message: Buying, selling, and the spawn market

rules.main.nether.main-tunnels.message: Our main nether tunnels extend north, south, east, and west from 0, 0. Players may not build in or edit the main nether tunnels which extend to approximately +/- 7 on each side of 0.

rules.main.nether.portal-connection.message: Your nether portal must connect to the closest main tunnel and can not have perpendicular side tunnels. If the tunnel you need is already taken, you must contact the person or staff to share the tunnel.

rules.main.nether.portal-height.message: Personal portals must be created or moved to 115 on the y axis in the nether and must sync properly with your portal in the Overworld.

rules.main.nether.portal-hubs.message: Personal portal hubs must be on the nether roof and are restricted to your personal base (750x750 in the overworld).

rules.main.nether.subtitle.message: Main tunnels, personal portals, and roof hubs

rules.main.nether.tunnel-format.message: Personal nether tunnels and portals must follow the proper size and layout format.

rules.main.nether.tunnel-size.message: Tunnels cannot exceed the max width and height of 9x9; this includes the walls, floor and roof.

rules.main.nether.tunnel-spacing.message: Personal nether tunnels are spaced every 10 blocks. Your personal tunnel should end in coordinates 1 and 9. Example: tunnel goes from 721 to 729

rules.main.nether.zero-coords.message: The blocks on the 0 cords should be left as is. Example: Block 720 and 730 are left netherrack

rules.main.proof.code.message: To confirm you've read these rules, include the code #BlameDragon in the Additional Questions section of your application.

rules.main.punishments.bans.message: Bans: may be immediate without warning depending on severity. Bans are permanent but may be appealed once. Denied appeals are final.

rules.main.punishments.not-step-by-step.message: <highlight>Not always step-by-step.</highlight> Serious violations can skip straight to a permanent ban without warning. Every ban may be appealed once — a denied appeal is final.

rules.main.punishments.subtitle.message: What happens when rules are broken

rules.main.punishments.warnings.message: Warnings: after 3 warnings, a player will be banned.

rules.main.safety.account-responsibility.message: You are responsible for your account. Don't share login. If compromised, contact staff ASAP.

rules.main.safety.community-content.message: Vanilla Tyme content may be shared in our <community-content-link>community content</community-content-link> channel.

rules.main.safety.english-only.message: English only in public game chat. Other languages allowed in DMs.

rules.main.safety.in-game-advertising.message: In-game advertising of goods/services: max once per hour in chat. Prefer the Discord <trade-link>Buy/Sell/Trade</trade-link> channel.

rules.main.safety.no-alt-accounts.message: No alt accounts. One Minecraft + one Discord account per player. Sharing internet with another player? Open a ticket and notify staff.

rules.main.safety.no-arguing.message: No arguing in public channels. You may discuss opposing views via DM — but if someone asks you to stop, you must comply.

rules.main.safety.no-doxxing.message: No Doxxing. Sharing private/identifying information about another person — name, location, social media — is prohibited.

rules.main.safety.no-excessive-swearing.message: No excessive or abusive swearing intended to offend, intimidate, or harm.

rules.main.safety.no-harassment.message: No harassment, disrespectful, derogatory, or abusive chat towards anyone, including staff.

rules.main.safety.no-harmful-content.message: No harmful, violent, or obscene content (NSFW, gore, self harm, drugs, etc.).

rules.main.safety.no-name-calling.message: No name calling or swearing at others.

rules.main.safety.no-offensive-content.message: No racist, anti-LGBTQ+, sexist, anti-religious, or otherwise offensive content.

rules.main.safety.no-other-servers.message: No promoting or mention of other Minecraft servers. (General content creator servers talk is fine.)

rules.main.safety.no-real-currency.message: No sales of items for real currency.

rules.main.safety.no-spam.message: No spam — repetitive, irrelevant, or unsolicited messages.

rules.main.safety.subtitle.message: How we treat each other in chat and voice

rules.main.spawn.area.message: Spawn extends 750 blocks in all directions from x0/z0. No building, mining, or gathering except in designated areas or with staff approval.

rules.main.spawn.events.message: Holiday/celebration events with free items: one item per player unless a sign says otherwise. You pick up your own — no picking up for others.

rules.main.support.general-questions.message: General questions use our <community-help-link>community help</community-help-link> Discord channel.

rules.main.support.no-staff-dms.message: Don't DM individual staff. Exception: if your issue is with a staff member, contact a developer directly.

rules.main.support.staff-in-game.message: Staff in-game may answer straightforward questions, but they may be busy/AFK. If no response, open a <ticket-link>ticket</ticket-link>.

rules.main.support.subtitle.message: How to get answers from staff

rules.main.support.tickets.message: Specific questions or anything needing staff make a <ticket-link>general support ticket</ticket-link> in Discord. Tickets get the fastest response.

rules.market.cta.description.message: Grab your Market Permit from Marty at spawn, then claim an open stall or plot. Questions? Open a ticket in our Discord.

rules.market.maintenance.good-standing.message: To stay in good standing, actively check inventory, collect payments, and/or restock your stall or shop at least once every 30 days.

rules.market.maintenance.inactive-remova.message: If your shop goes inactive for over 30 days it will be removed without notice and your Market Permit will be revoked. All shop contents are donated to spawn.

rules.market.maintenance.reopening.message: Once a shop is removed or closed, you may reopen by purchasing a new shop permit.

rules.market.maintenance.subtitle.message: Keep your shop active or lose it

rules.market.overview.choose-spot.message: Choose between a pre-built stall or a blank plot to build your own shop. The full process is below.

rules.market.overview.currency-sign.message: Display your shop's currency on a sign so pricing is clear. You can request any payment (diamonds, iron, etc.) as long as it's clearly marked and consistent.

rules.market.overview.no-stall-and-shop.message: No player may have a stall and a shop at the same time.

rules.market.overview.sharing.message: You can share a shop with other players — but no player may be part of more than one shop or stall at a time. Each player needs their own permit.

rules.market.permits.display.message: Every shop/stall member must buy and display their own Market Permit, visible in the stall/shop immediately after claiming.

rules.market.permits.marty.message: Marty the Market Master sells permits at the permit office located in spawn x0 z-116 for 2 diamond blocks each.

rules.market.permits.no-giving.message: You may not give away or sell your permit to any player.

rules.market.permits.no-moving.message: Don't remove or move the permit of any shop/stall you're not a member of.

rules.market.permits.own-permit.message: Each player must purchase their own permit.

rules.market.permits.subtitle.message: Required for every shop or stall member

rules.market.permits.switching.message: To switch between a stall and a plot, fully vacate your current spot first, open a ticket to notify staff, and move your permit to the new spot.

rules.market.shops.build-height.message: Max build height is 40 blocks above natural ground level. Builds may descend up to 10 blocks below your floor level.

rules.market.shops.claiming.message: To claim a plot, replace the vacant sign with your in-game name and the date you claimed. Obtain a Market Permit first and display it immediately. If none are open, you'll have to wait.

rules.market.shops.entity-limits.message: Shops may use no more than 32 player heads, 64 item frames, and 16 armor stands.

rules.market.shops.invisible-item-frames.message: Empty invisible item frames may not be used in shops.

rules.market.shops.lighting.message: All shops must be lit so mobs cannot spawn — including roofs.

rules.market.shops.marked-plots.message: All plot locations are clearly marked with concrete at the corners. You may not create your own plot.

rules.market.shops.plot-dimensions.message: All plots are 20×20 blocks. Only banners, trapdoors, buttons, and signs may overhang the plot.

rules.market.shops.redstone.message: Redstone is allowed in limited quantity:

rules.market.shops.redstone.no-farms.message: No farms anywhere in the market area

rules.market.shops.subtitle.message: Build your own on a blank 20×20 plot

rules.market.shops.switching.message: To switch to a stall, remove all blocks from your plot first, then open a ticket to notify staff.

rules.market.shops.terraforming.message: Minimal terraforming of the ground is allowed.

rules.market.stalls.claiming.message: To claim a stall, replace the vacant sign with your in-game name and the date you claimed. You must obtain a Market Permit first and display it immediately. If none are open, you'll have to wait — availability isn't guaranteed.

rules.market.stalls.container-limit.message: Each stall may have a maximum of 10 barrels/chests (a double chest counts as 2). You may not add more.

rules.market.stalls.decorations.message: You may add signs, banners, and up to 3 decorative player heads to promote your stall. Decorations must be attached to the stall.

rules.market.stalls.rearranging.message: You may rearrange the barrels and chests, but you may not remove, add, or swap out any of the stall's blocks.

rules.market.stalls.subtitle.message: Pre-built & ready to sell — first come, first served

vote.faq.collectibles.answer-1.message: Collectibles are special items that you can obtain from voting and turn in to get various perks. Some collectibles have special desirable characteristics that cannot be obtained in vanilla Minecraft while others are just for show. All Collectibles can be identified by the “Collectible” text in the lore of the item. Collectibles are commonly traded, bought, and sold between players.

vote.faq.collectibles.answer-2.message: All staff have a collectible named for them. Players have the ability to get a collectible named for them by winning early map competitions or by turning in sets of collectibles.

vote.faq.trophies.answer-1.message: Trophies are special items awarded to players. Trophies can commonly be obtained as milestone voting swords (every 50 votes), holiday gifts, event gifts, competition prizes, weekly competition prizes, mini-game winner prizes and more.

vote.faq.trophies.answer-2.message: All Trophies can be identified by the “Trophy” text in the lore of the item. Like collectibles, trophies are commonly traded, bought, and sold between players in game.

vote.faq.trophies.answer-3.message: 5 Trophies can be traded in for one Collectible. Contact a staff member in game or through discord support when you are ready to trade the trophies in. You will be given a Collectible Scoop.

Once you have the required number of unique collectibles, you can exchange them for any of the available options in that tier. Choose wisely - traded collectibles are consumed in the process.
